en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing a large historicist building on a sloping plot, with ornate gables, tall windows, and a slender spire-like turret. The architecture features stepped and curved gables, brick details around the windows, and a steep tiled roof with dormers, typical of late 19th–early 20th century Central European civic or school buildings. The foreground has a fenced garden and small trees; in the background are other town buildings and low hills.
